manifest.provenance: Hand-parameterized industrial load shapes for Egyptian food-processing and textile factories. Each shape is a 24/7 base/standby load plus a production block during shift hours, reduced on the weekly rest day. These profiles are synthetic and are NOT derived from measured factory interval data; they encode plausible operating patterns only.
limitations: Not validated against measured Egyptian factory load.
Intra-day shape is representative, not measured.
Cross-month seasonality comes entirely from user monthly kWh, not the archetype.

food_processing|day_shift.notes: High refrigeration standby load runs 24/7 including the rest day.

textiles|day_shift.notes: Lower standby; most load tracks the production shift.
